task.description:
Design and write test specs and test code for OIDC-10 (Attribute Synchronisation and Role Reconciliation).

Per the design doc at src/design/oidc-10-attribute-sync.md, the test strategy is:
- Unit tests for the pure role reconciliation algorithm (partition, diff, set operations)
- Integration tests for the full attribute sync + role reconciliation flow against real PostgreSQL

Create:
1. tests/specs/OIDC-10.md — test specification document covering all test cases
2. Test source code for OIDC-10 attribute sync:
   - Unit tests in src/oidc/jit_provisioning.zig (or a dedicated test file) for:
     * Role reconciliation algorithm: add_set and remove_set computation
     * Profile comparison logic
     * Edge cases: empty token roles, no OIDC-sourced roles, all roles locally-assigned
   - Integration tests in tests/ for:
     * Full flow: resolve user → compare profile → update if changed → reconcile roles
     * Profile sync: display_name, email, status updates when claims differ
     * Profile no-op: no update when claims match stored values
     * Role reconciliation: add new OIDC roles, remove stale OIDC roles
     * Role preservation: locally-assigned roles survive reconciliation
     * Role overlap: role is both OIDC-sourced and locally-assigned (should not be deleted)
     * Empty token roles: all OIDC-sourced roles removed, local ones preserved
     * Error handling: user not found returns error.UserNotFound
     * Best-effort wiring: sync failure does not block auth

IMPORTANT: Per DIRECTIVE T-1, do NOT use mocks, stubs, or in-memory fakes. Integration tests MUST connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL. Unit tests (pure algorithm) can be in-memory.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/OIDC-10.md is created with all test cases documented
Test code exists for both unit tests (pure algorithm) and integration tests (against real DB)
All acceptance criteria from OIDC-10 are covered by at least one test
No mocks, stubs, or in-memory fakes in integration tests

result.summary: Test specs and test code for OIDC-10 attribute sync and role reconciliation
